name: settings-layout
title: Settings UI Layout Optimization
description: Fix poor layout in settings dialog: labels and controls misaligned, action buttons pushed to far right, no max-width constraints, inconsistent label widths across forms.
creator: re2zero
notes: Fixed settings UI layout: standardized label widths, added max_w constraints to cards/forms, improved setting_row layout, converted raw h_flex to setting_row for terminal controls.

layout_issues_fixed: terminal tab: setting_row no longer uses justify_between
mcp form: label width changed from 60px to 100px
api form: label width changed from 80px to 100px for consistency
cards: added max_w(px(600.)) to mcp_card, api_provider_card, mcp_agent_entry_with_test, agent_detail_panel
inline edit forms: added max_w(px(600.)) to mcp_inline_edit_card, api_inline_edit_card
add forms: added max_w(px(600.)) to mcp_add_form, api_provider_form
skill cards: changed fixed w(px(200.)) to min_w/max_w range
terminal tab: opacity section converted from raw h_flex to setting_row
terminal tab: cursor style section converted from raw h_flex to setting_row
content lists: added max_w(px(600.)) to card list containers in api/mcp/skills tabs
